title: [NSW] 3 Free Pastizzi & Drink Per Day @ Gato's, Carramar
body:
Deal: [NSW] 3 Free Pastizzi & Drink Per Day @ Gato's, Carramar

[George Washington] hopefully this deal doesnt get ozbargained
[FrugalFrogposter] 100% - Gato's pastizzi are the real deal, hoping people do right by them.
[d1020n] Would love to see people pay it forward too!
[aragornelessar] Looks like they're going to try and set something up for people to pay it forward
https://www.facebook.com/share/p/19q29Wi8Ln/
[AustriaBargain] You mean people showing up just for the 3 Free Pastizzi + Drink? Isn't that the point, or do you think OZBargainer's are impervious to becoming repeat customers because of our laser dogged focus on a good deal.
[Thermal] I think the point is, it's the sort of offer that shouldn't make you think, "great, free lunch each day for 2 months", if you can reasonably afford to pay for it.
That clearly doesn't preclude ozbargainers taking up the offer one or more times, but there's a wide difference between accepting a bit of generosity (we all have days that such goes a long way, even if we can afford to pay for our lunch) versus abusing that generosity.
Sure this deal might generate some repeat business from paying customers so they could write some off as a marketing cost, but the nature of it is clearly more than that.
[BargainBadger] Amazing. What a nice thing to see. Thanks Gatos for being brilliant. I will try and do the same.
[movieman] Well done Gatos.
And love your website name.
Malta would be proud!
[scud70] Every now and then there are people who prove that there are still decent humans in this world. If I'm ever in the area (nowhere near me unfortunately) i will be popping by and buying from them and i hope people do the right thing by Gatos and not take advantage of the generosity.
[dingle] Their ricotta cheese pastizzis and cannolis are my favourites.
[usbc activist] I drive past this restaurant and want to try it. But, during the times I drive, it is already closed. I need to plan sometime.
[usbc activist] One small thought. This cafe is next to cross care Carramarr which is visited by a number of disabled kids and their parents. He can give them gift them some boxes. They would be really happy.
